claim: The bank-1 front-end helpers do not materialize a WRAM table at $1E80. The overlapping stores to $10/$11/$12 construct the long ROM pointer 1E:8000, and L00179B/L001662 then dereference rows from that table directly.

rendering.preview_note: Rendered previews treat nonzero 4bpp pixels as grayscale, reinterpret descriptor x/y words as signed local offsets, and normalize the preview origin to the descriptor bounds before replaying the staged 4bpp OBJ blob.
